# awscc_mediaconnect_flow_media_stream (Resource)

Resource schema for AWS::MediaConnect::FlowMediaStream. A media stream represents a single track or stream of media containing video, audio, or ancillary data that is transported using the SMPTE 2110 JPEG XS or CDI protocol.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flow_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the flow that the media stream belongs to.
- `media_stream_id` (Number) A unique identifier for the media stream.
- `media_stream_name` (String) A name that helps you distinguish one media stream from another.
- `media_stream_type` (String) The type of media stream.

### Optional

- `attributes` (Attributes) Attributes that are related to the media stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes))
- `clock_rate` (Number) The sample rate (in Hz) for the stream. If the media stream type is video or ancillary data, set this value to 90000. If the media stream type is audio, set this value to either 48000 or 96000.
- `description` (String) A description that can help you quickly identify what your media stream is used for.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The key-value pairs that can be used to tag and organize the media stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `video_format` (String) The resolution of the video. Required for a video media stream and rejected for other media stream types.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the media stream, composed of the flow ARN followed by /mediaStream/ and the media stream name.
- `fmt` (Number) The format type number (sometimes referred to as RTP payload type) of the media stream. MediaConnect assigns this value to the media stream.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes`

Optional:

- `fmtp` (Attributes) A set of parameters that define the media stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes--fmtp))
- `lang` (String) The audio language, in a format that is recognized by the receiver. Can only be specified for an audio media stream.

<a id="nestedatt--attributes--fmtp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes.fmtp`

Optional:

- `channel_order` (String) The format of the audio channel. Can only be specified for an audio media stream.
- `colorimetry` (String) The format used for the representation of color.
- `exact_framerate` (String) The frame rate for the video stream, in frames/second. For example: 60000/1001.
- `par` (String) The pixel aspect ratio (PAR) of the video.
- `range` (String) The encoding range of the video.
- `scan_mode` (String) The type of compression that was used to smooth the video's appearance.
- `tcs` (String) The transfer characteristic system (TCS) that is used in the video.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mediaconnect_flow_media_stream.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the media stream, composed of the flow ARN followed by /mediaStream/ and the media stream name

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mediaconnect_flow_media_stream.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_mediaconnect_flow_media_stream.example "arn"
```
